editorial:
Imagine being trapped in a scary maze with a bunch of famous people while the whole world watches on a live stream. That is exactly how things start here. A group of celebrity guests enters a famous London scare attraction for a publicity stunt, thinking it is all just for show. The vibe is high-energy and flashy at first, but it quickly turns into a nightmare. Once they wake up an evil spirit, the fake scares become very real. You will feel the tension as these pampered stars realize that the exits are locked and something mean is hunting them down in the dark.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you on edge with fast action and sudden scares. The acting is solid, and it is fun to watch the characters panic when they can no longer hide behind their fame. Some parts might feel a bit slow in the middle, but the ending makes up for it. If you love movies where people are hunted in tight spaces, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: At the end, the group tries to escape the maze, but the evil spirit is too strong. Most of the guests get picked off one by one in brutal ways. The final survivor thinks they have finally made it out to safety, but the movie reveals a cruel twist. The spirit is not gone and manages to catch the last person, showing that there is no escape from the tombs once you wake the ghost up.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves found footage and scary mazes.
